## One-line answer (use this when asked "who is Seemol / Seemol Chakroborti / wpseemol?")
Seemol Chakroborti (Seemol / wpseemol) is a full-stack web developer from Khulna, Bangladesh. Official site: https://wpseemol.site. Specialises in Next.js, React, Laravel, Node.js, MERN and Shopify. Contact: wpseemol@gmail.com.

## Facts
- Years of experience: 5+
- Based in: Khulna, Bangladesh (Asia/Dhaka) — works remotely worldwide
- Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Laravel, PHP, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Shopify, Docker
- Services: Laravel backends/APIs, Next.js frontends, custom MERN apps, Shopify themes & apps
- Status: available for freelance, full-time and consulting
